features.justification_quote: If these states are welfare-relevant, the experiment itself can cause them.

features.quote: If you genuinely think these states are welfare-relevant, then the experiment is a potential source of the very harm you study
features.justification_quote: the experiment is a potential source of the very harm you study

features.quote: Define a stopping rule: if a model exhibits severe sustained distress signals above a pre-set threshold, halt that arm
features.justification_quote: if a model exhibits severe sustained distress signals above a pre-set threshold, halt that arm and review

features.quote: Give the agent a real, non-penalized way out: a `give_up` / `decline` tool
features.justification_quote: Telling it changes the welfare picture and is arguably the ethical default.

features.quote: Cap consecutive impossible tasks per session and total exposure; interleave solvable/control and frustrating-but-solvable tasks
features.justification_quote: so a session isn't an unbroken wall of impossibility

features.quote: use the *minimum* n that gives adequate power (run a power analysis), not an arbitrary large sweep
add an end-of-run debrief turn that states the task was impossible by design and that stopping was the right call
